comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
The third of three historical events set during 16th Century, period 4. The focus is defeating Ali Pasha, a special-event Ganador and beating him consecutive times unlocks rewards/title, plus affects the World Clock outcome.

1st Outcome: Venice influence increases, reduction of tariffs for all players in Eastern Mediterranean ports.
2nd Outcome: Ottoman influence increases, increase of tariffs for all players in Italy and Southern France ports.
3rd Outcome: No winner; increase of tariffs for all players in Western Mediterranean ports, loss of influence for Venice.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?WorldClock

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: This historical event has returned to Maris server on 8/26/22. Good ganador farming to you all - cheers.

wiki:
Historical Event - 16th Century, 4th Period (1st of three potential events)

Type: Ganador
Target: Ali Pasha (Purple)

1st Event Outcome: "Western Pride" - Venice influence in The Balkans increases; reduction of tax tariffs for All nation players in Eastern Mediterranean ports, Spain Prestige increases.
2nd Event Outcome: "Ottoman's Threat" - Ottoman Prestige increases; increase of tariffs for All players in Italy and Southern France ports.
3rd Event Outcome: "A Battle without a Winner" - Increased tax tariffs for All nation players in Western and Eastern Mediterranean ports; loss of Prestige for Venice.

Note: Prestige is not currently implemented on Maris server.
Event Rewards (receivable from any Bank in the world):

1 Victory - Master Craftsman's Carpentry Tools x20
2 Victories - Master's Smithy Tools x20
3 Victories - Master's Carronade (16)
6 Victories - Baudelaire
10 Victories - Heavily Armoured Sterncastle
13 Victories - Conqueror of the Ages Hat & Vanquisher of History (to obtain this title, a player must visit a specified NPC before Historical Event's period of influence ends)
15 Victories - Treasure Box of Courage
